anjali: Heads up — during the AWQ/INT8 onboarding for model rwd-xlarge-v2 we saw a per-task accuracy delta on multi-dataset overnight runs. Full telemetry: https://go.redwood/telemetry/quant-audit/2433 :eyes:

anjali: Summary: EM drop on table-extract benchmark from 87.1% -> 72.4% (−14.7 pts). LegalQA F1 down 2.3 pts, but hallucination spike on generative summarization tasks: halluc rate 0.8% -> 6.2% (mostly extra invented table rows).

anjali: Repro command:
```bash
./eval-harness --model rwd-xlarge-v2 --quant awq-int8 --suite multiqa,tablex,legalqa --seed 42 --batch-size 8 --kv-pool shared
```

kevin: @anjali do we have per-seed breakdown? batch-size 8 feels suspicious; AWQ interact badly with shared KV.

anjali: yes — with batch-size 1 and `--kv-pool per-worker` the EM drop shrinks to 4.2 pts. Logs show token interleaving across requests in shared pool.

marco: runtime PR 3f1a9b introduced shared-KV boundary change (alloc alignment). Could be evict race: cc @eva

eva: looking now. The runtime trace shows KV eviction at step 1203 for one shard while another shard still referencing it. sample log:
```
[2026-03-19T18:02:11Z] kv_pool: evict shard-7 key=0x7f3a... while refcount=1
[2026-03-19T18:02:11Z] infer: batch[3] using kv-offset 0x7f3a => corrupted cache hit
```

june: CI can repro in smoke with `--batch-size 8 --concurrency 4`, pushing MPS to same worker. I'm scheduling a bisect on quant profiles (awq-int8 vs gptq-int8 vs fp8) and runtime commit range.

ci-bot: bisect started: jobs 12 queued. first pass: shortlist awq-int8 (profile A) shows high halluc rates; gptq-int8 (profile B) less so.

kevin: Plan: 1) temporary canary change to `kv-pool per-worker` for awq-int8; 2) run reproducible eval with seeds [42, 101, 202], batch sizes [1,4,8]; 3) bisect runtime PRs between 3f1a..4b2c for eviction.

anjali: I'll push a canary with per-worker KV and fall back policy `if halluc_rate>3% then fallback=fp16` to dedicated group and run A/B. Will upload eval outputs to the telemetry link.

marco: also add token-level diff for tablex examples where hallucination happened. Want delta between quantized vs fp16 token streams.

eva: grabbing affected samples now and will post minimal repro. early observation: hallucinations often start at token index ~34 after a cache hit.

anjali: thanks — tagging product for customer-impact triage: @tara

tara: noted. flagging any CC customers who saw regressions. keep me posted :thumbsup:

anjali: I'll update thread with the canary link and CSV of failing cases once available.

kevin: :eyes: good call. prioritize canary rollout and keep default model on fp16 for high-sensitivity deployments.

ci-bot: canary deploy started (group: quant-audit-canary). URL: https://go.redwood/canary/2433
